messages.content: I’m ready to settle the Nashville hotel. Before booking, compare the full two-night totals again and make sure the room is one king for both Morgan and me.

For Friday, November 27 through Sunday, November 29, Homewood Suites Nashville Vanderbilt has one king studio suite for two adults at $631.26 complete, including estimated taxes and two nights of self-parking. Kimpton Aertson has one standard king for two adults at $827.06 complete, including estimated taxes, its amenity fee, and two nights of valet parking. The Kimpton is $195.80 more.
And neither one is actually the Hutton, correct? I don’t want us making that assumption just because the Kimpton is closer.

Correct. Both are separate hotels. Homewood Suites is about 0.9 mile from the Hutton, and Kimpton Aertson is about 0.7 mile away. Either would still require a short rideshare after the Saturday reception unless you chose to walk.
Please check the Hutton itself one last time. If a king has opened for both nights, put it into the comparison with every required charge.

A standard king has become available at the Hutton for both nights and allows two adults. The complete stay is $903.48: $718.00 room charge, $113.08 estimated lodging tax, and $72.40 for two nights of valet parking. There is no separate mandatory resort or destination fee on this offer. Free cancellation ends at 6:00 p.m. Central on Tuesday, November 24; after that, the stated penalty is $359.00 plus applicable tax.
So compare Hutton against Homewood only. Include the transportation difference and Friday arrival.

Homewood Suites is $631.26 complete and remains refundable through 11:59 p.m. Central Wednesday, November 25. It is usually a five- to nine-minute rideshare to the Hutton, so you would need transportation to Friday’s 7:00 p.m. dinner and back after Saturday’s reception. Leaving Atlanta at 1:30 p.m. Eastern still supports an arrival around 5:30 p.m. Central, allowing time to check in and change before requesting a ride.

The Hutton is $903.48 complete, or $272.22 more. The dinner, ceremony, and reception are all in the same building, so there is no event transportation to arrange. The same projected 5:30 p.m. arrival leaves about ninety minutes before dinner. Its free-cancellation deadline is one day earlier than Homewood’s.
Does the Homewood total definitely include parking? We’ll have our car, but it can stay parked once we arrive.

Yes. The $631.26 Homewood total includes estimated taxes and self-parking for both Friday and Saturday nights. There is no mandatory destination fee. Event rideshares are not included; allowing for four short trips over the weekend would add roughly $45 to $70 depending on demand.
That still leaves it more than two hundred dollars below the Hutton. Confirm the king studio isn’t one king plus an assumption that one of us uses the sofa bed.

Confirmed. The occupancy is entered as two adults, and the assigned room type has one king bed. The sofa bed is additional sleeping space, not required to accommodate the second guest. Both Avery Thompson and Morgan Thompson can be listed on the reservation.
Book Homewood, then. Put Morgan on the room, and keep the refundable rate. I accept that we’ll use rideshares for the Hutton events.

Homewood Suites Nashville Vanderbilt is reserved for Avery and Morgan Thompson from Friday, November 27 through Sunday, November 29. The room is a king studio suite for two adults, and the refundable rate was retained.

Confirmation: HWV-482731. The complete two-night amount is $631.26, including estimated taxes and two nights of self-parking, with no mandatory destination fee. No event rideshares are included. Free cancellation is available through 11:59 p.m. Central on Wednesday, November 25; after that, the estimated penalty is $279.63. Plan to leave Atlanta at 1:30 p.m. Eastern for an expected arrival near 5:30 p.m. Central, then take a short rideshare to the Hutton for the 7:00 p.m. family dinner.
